card.name: Words about buying and selling goods
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of a sentence about buying, selling or finding products, such as "from", "to", "sold" or "at", just before the place or channel is named. Seen in general consumer text about stores, supermarkets and sales.

modes.label: Link word after purchase verb
modes.description: A small word like from, at, or, on that follows buy, purchase, spent or scout out and leads into a store or outlet.
modes.example: Its best to purchase food-grade water storage containers<< from>> surplus or camping supplies stores.

modes.label: Sold or seen in shops
modes.description: The verb sold or seen, or a noun for goods, where products are available in a store.
modes.example: Rolls of dried reeds (<<sold>> as portable screens in garden centres) can

card.plain: It lights up in sentences about where things are bought or sold, right before the shop or sales channel is named.
